title: Slime Seed
wikitext:
{{{{{1|Seeds Infobox}}} |image = Slime Seed |Crop = Slime Berry |Growth = 13 days |Season = {{Season|Spring}} |Sell Price = 0 |gPrice = ''Not sold'' |jPrice = ''Not sold'' |tPrice = ''Not sold'' }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a type of seed that can be planted in the {{Season|Spring}}. Mature plants yield [[Slime Berry]] after 13 days and continue to produce every 4 days. Seeds cannot be purchased, but they can be obtained by eliminating [[Slimes]] in [[The Highlands]] and by placing Slime Berry in the [[Stardew:Seed maker|Seed Maker]]. Mature plants will produce 1 – 3 Slime Berries per harvest with a 3% chance of extra produce per harvest and a 10% chance of extra harvest per each [[Stardew:Farming#Farming Skill|Farming Skill]] level. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Slime Berry}} {{clear}}
